propositions: A plan asserts that a named module provides a capability when the module actually lacks that capability (dc58: completion.py missing signing; db7b: REVIEW_RESULT not compact-eligible)
A plan asserts that a capability must be built or is absent when the named module already provides it (5886: unmapped-Jira-status already emitted)
The asserted-capability criterion must be registered as advisory, code-grounded, AGENT-tier, non-orphan and routed in criteria_routing.json with default_posture="advisory"

The criterion ships with a rubric prompt, guide section, deterministic unit tests, and a bounded sanity fixture set demonstrating >=2/3 recall on E1-verified misses with advisory-posture false-fires recorded for promotion-gate dogfood
The criterion auto-flows into the standing effectiveness recorder with zero per-criterion wiring
The advisory posture and future blocking promotion gate are documented in the rubric and cited against the advisory→blocking promotion protocol
